description: Everything RepoAlerts knows about one GitHub repository (owner/name or URL): what it is and who it's for, stars and recent growth, a summary of its star curve, licence, last push, the apps it can replace, Hacker News stories and similar repos. Use it to check a repo before recommending or installing it. If the repo isn't in the directory, it says so (it may be unknown or excluded for fake stars).

locale.description: Language of the summaries: 'en' (default) or 'es' for Spanish. Use 'es' when the user writes in Spanish.

repo.description: The repository as 'owner/name' (e.g. 'vercel/next.js'), or its GitHub or RepoAlerts URL.
